comment: Each of D5, L5, Q5, R5 has polar {x : <x,p> ≤ 1 for all code points p} with max |x|^2 = 5/4 < 2. Therefore none of the four published 40-point codes admits a 41st kissing point. Replay: polar_vertices.py (C) and --python (Q5, R5); replay_max_vertex.py solves the recorded tight planes over Q.
